designBasis.quote: A Phase 3, Multicenter, Randomized, Open-Label, Active-Controlled Study of DS-8201a (Trastuzumab Deruxtecan), an Anti-HER2 Antibody Drug Conjugate (ADC), Versus Ado Trastuzumab Emtansine (T-DM1) for HER2-Positive, Unresectable and/or Metastatic Breast Cancer Subjects Previously Treated With Trastuzumab and Taxane

assessment.reason: Appraise the exact existing resolved result using its native study/version/result digest and the original retained registry file.

answers.value: The selected retained result is the T-DXd arm’s median progression-free survival assessed by blinded independent central review. The registry defines PFS from enrollment to first documented progression under RECIST v1.1 or death from any cause. The full analysis set is reported at 21 May 2021, up to 33 months. T-DXd has 261 participants and comparator T-DM1 has 263. T-DXd’s median and upper confidence limit are reported as NA, with a lower 95% confidence bound of 18.5 months; the registry explicitly attributes non-estimability to an insufficient number of events. The companion T-DM1 median is 6.8 months with bounds 5.6 and 8.2.
answers.rationale: Appraise this saved group result in its original comparative context. Preserve NA as the registry’s stated non-estimable result, separate from absent reporting and from the numeric lower bound.
